beaches.name: Brighton Naturist Beach (Cliff Bathing Beach)
beaches.summary: Nude and clothed use mix across the signed naturist beach east of Brighton Pier. Visit Brighton, the city's council-backed tourism guide, states Brighton opened it on 1 April 1980, that it is officially known as Cliff Bathing Beach, that signs mark where it commences and that pebble banks provide screening. No enforcement note is given.
